newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Budget moves win confidence on Mauritius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Budget moves win confidence on Mauritius bourse.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse index Semdex rose by 4.82 points on Friday to 388.61, stimulated by government budgetary measures to restore confidence in the business community, brokers said.
Volume surged to 26.85 million rupees on 1,685,979 shares, from 11.82 million rupees on 478,895 shares on Wednesday.

In the banking sector, blue chip Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was 1.00 rupee higher to 90.00 rupees on 19,882 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) gained 20 cents to 12.00 rupees on 390,767 shares.
"There has been buying interest from foreign investors in SBM during today's trading session," one broker said.

New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) rose 20 cents to 37.20 rupees on 25,644 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) climbed 10 cents to 48.20 rupees on 1,500 shares and Sun Resorts was stable at 51.50 rupees on 11,938 shares.

Commerce companies Happy World Foods (HWF) lost 1.00 rupee to 15.00 rupees on 1,065,000 shares, Rogers surged 3.00 rupees to 99.00 rupees on 524 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) climbed 20 cents to 16.20 rupees on 52,540 shares.

In the industry sector, Mauritius Breweries Ltd MALL.MZ (MBL) edged 4.00 rupees to 150.00 rupees on 560 shares, United Basalt Products (UBP) gained 90 cents to 34.40 rupees on 800 shares and Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers (MSM) rose 50 cents to 53.00 rupees on 100 shares.

In the investment sector, Fincorp was unchanged to 72.00 rupees on 4,000 shares, Mauritius Development Investment Trust (MDIT) was 10 cents up to 7.60 rupees on 17,772 shares and Promotion And Development (PAD) climbed 80 cents to 15.00 rupees on 8,300 shares.
Sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) rose 1.00 rupee to 42.30 rupees on 3,578 shares and Harel Freres lost 1.00 rupee to 56.00 rupees, but was not quoted.
Air Mauritius eased 20 cents to 38.80 rupees on 1,965 shares.
